logicalBugs.description: In Gitea’s account’s repository settings list, opening a page number beyond the available pages shows “You do not own any repositories.” The account still owns repositories on earlier pages, so an out-of-range page is incorrectly described as having no repositories at all.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The repositories template selects its no-repositories message from the paginated collection, and the handler never clamps an out-of-range page before fetching it.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea’s account’s repository settings list, opening a page number beyond the available pages shows “You do not own any repositories.” The account still owns repositories on earlier pages, so an out-of-range page is incorrectly described as having no repositories at all.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s Followers tab shows a grid of user cards containing names and profile details. At phone width those details do not fit the columns: names and URLs fragment or overflow rather than remaining readable within each card.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The user card CSS retains a floated 48px avatar and fixed content margins while the grid narrows, leaving insufficient width for names and metadata.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea profile’s Followers tab at phone width, inspect the grid of follower cards. Their names and secondary profile details break into fragments or overflow the narrow columns instead of fitting as readable cards.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, in profile settings, clear a previously saved Full Name and submit the update. The page reports success but repopulates the old name, which remains after refresh, instead of saving the cleared value or explaining why it was rejected.
logicalBugs.rootCause: ProfilePost sets the optional FullName update only when form.FullName is nonempty; clearing the field therefore omits the update.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, in profile settings, clear a previously saved Full Name and submit the update. The page reports success but repopulates the old name, which remains after refresh, instead of saving the cleared value or explaining why it was rejected.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, settings > Blocked Users lets a user enter an account name to block. Submitting a name that does not correspond to any account opens a full-page Internal Server Error instead of keeping the form available with an account-not-found message.
logicalBugs.rootCause: BlockedUsersPost sends every GetUserByName error, including not-found, to ServerError instead of returning form validation.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, settings > Blocked Users lets a user enter an account name to block. Submitting a name that does not correspond to any account opens a full-page Internal Server Error instead of keeping the form available with an account-not-found message.

logicalBugs.description: On a Gitea profile with no followers, the “0 Followers” link opens the Followers tab. That tab is an unexplained blank content area rather than a message confirming there are no followers, so the empty state gives no feedback about the result.
logicalBugs.rootCause: user_cards ranges over Cards and emits a pager but supplies no else branch for an empty collection.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea profile with no followers, the “0 Followers” link opens the Followers tab. That tab is an unexplained blank content area rather than a message confirming there are no followers, so the empty state gives no feedback about the result.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s profile settings page introduces its controls with “Control how your profile is show to other users.” The sentence uses “show” where “shown” is needed; this is a grammar error in the introduction rather than a profile-visibility failure.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The profile_desc locale literal says profile is show rather than shown.
reproductionPaths: Gitea’s profile settings page introduces its controls with “Control how your profile is show to other users.” The sentence uses “show” where “shown” is needed; this is a grammar error in the introduction rather than a profile-visibility failure.

logicalBugs.description: On another Gitea user’s Followers tab, Follow/Unfollow updates the profile sidebar count and button but leaves the follower-card list unchanged. Your card is not added after Follow or removed after Unfollow until the page reloads.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The follow controls target only #profile-avatar-card; user-cards refreshes on refreshUserCards, and this flow does not refresh that separate list.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea user's Followers tab, clicking Unfollow updates the sidebar count and button to Follow, but your follower card stays in the list until the page is reloaded.
On a Gitea user's Followers tab, clicking Follow updates the sidebar count and button to Unfollow, but your follower card isn't added to the list until the page is reloaded.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, at a narrow phone width, the avatar image upload field in account settings extends past its settings card and the screen edge. The file control is clipped instead of fitting within the form, making part of the visible upload interface unreadable.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The file input is rendered without a responsive width/max-width constraint, retaining the native chooser intrinsic width.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, at a narrow phone width, the avatar image upload field in account settings extends past its settings card and the screen edge. The file control is clipped instead of fitting within the form, making part of the visible upload interface unreadable.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, submitting a profile with an unsupported Website URL displays a validation error but re-renders the profile form with previously saved values, discarding unsaved Full Name, Biography, Website, and Location edits.
logicalBugs.rootCause: ProfilePost returns tplSettingsProfile on HasError before updating the user, while the template binds fields to SignedUser rather than the submitted form.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, submitting a profile with an unsupported Website URL displays a validation error but re-renders the profile form with previously saved values, discarding unsaved Full Name, Biography, Website, and Location edits.

logicalBugs.description: On a Gitea user profile's repository tabs at phone width, the Filter and Sort menus open upward from their buttons even though there is room below, so their top options are cut off above the screen and cannot be scrolled into view.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The shared search dropdowns have neither explicit downward class nor bounded scroll region; common-page leaves their direction on Fomantic auto, whose viewport guessing can clip the menu.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea user profile's repository tabs at phone width, the Filter and Sort menus open upward from their buttons even though there is room below, so their top options are cut off above the screen and cannot be scrolled into view.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, validation errors show internal field keys instead of visible field names: examples include profile Website, release Tag name/Title, branch rename, protected-tag pattern and repository Default Branch. The input can be correctly rejected while the banner says form.Website, form.TagName or a similar untranslated key.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Validate constructs form.<GoField> labels; Website has no matching translated field label and URL validation appends its internal Url message argument.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, saving the profile with an invalid Website URL shows an error banner that names the field with an internal translation key, form.Website"Url", instead of the readable field name.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s Website field's browser check accepts any URL scheme, so values such as javascript:, mailto: or ftp: URLs pass it and are only rejected by the server after submitting, while text such as fooo is blocked in the browser with 'Please enter a URL.'
logicalBugs.rootCause: The field uses generic HTML type=url but the server applies ValidSiteUrl, which requires an allowed site scheme. Unsupported URLs pass the former and fail the latter.
reproductionPaths: Gitea’s Website field's browser check accepts any URL scheme, so values such as javascript:, mailto: or ftp: URLs pass it and are only rejected by the server after submitting, while text such as fooo is blocked in the browser with 'Please enter a URL.'

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, a regular user can block an administrator account, and the block is listed under Settings > Blocked Users, but clicking Unblock on it fails with 'cannot unblock the user' and the administrator stays on the list.
logicalBugs.rootCause: CanUnblockUser checks IsUserBlockedBy; that helper unconditionally returns false for admins despite an existing stored block, making unblock fail.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, a regular user can block an administrator account, and the block is listed under Settings > Blocked Users, but clicking Unblock on it fails with 'cannot unblock the user' and the administrator stays on the list.

logicalBugs.description: Gitea’s profile contribution calendar groups activity by the browser's local day, but clicking a day filters the activity list by that date in the server's timezone. For viewers in another timezone, a day's square can open an empty list or a list that doesn't match its contribution count.
logicalBugs.rootCause: ActivityHeatmap constructs the clicked date in the browser timezone, while FeedDateCond parses that date using DefaultUILocation, so the requested time interval need not match the calendar bucket.
reproductionPaths: Gitea’s profile contribution calendar groups activity by the browser's local day, but clicking a day filters the activity list by that date in the server's timezone. For viewers in another timezone, a day's square can open an empty list or a list that doesn't match its contribution count.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, uploading an avatar that is slightly over the 1 MiB limit is correctly rejected, but the error reads 'The uploaded file size (1024 KiB) exceeds the maximum size (1024 KiB).' The file size is rounded down to whole KiB, so any file up to 1023 bytes over the limit shows the same number as the maximum.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The error formats both byte counts using integer division by 1024, dropping the excess fractional KiB.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, uploading an avatar that is slightly over the 1 MiB limit is correctly rejected, but the error reads 'The uploaded file size (1024 KiB) exceeds the maximum size (1024 KiB).' The file size is rounded down to whole KiB, so any file up to 1023 bytes over the limit shows the same number as the maximum.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, searching a user’s or organization’s Projects list filters the rows but reloads with an empty search box. Sorting or switching Open/Closed afterwards drops that now-hidden query and restores unrelated projects.
logicalBugs.rootCause: Projects reads q and filters results but never assigns Keyword into template data. The field, status links and sort links therefore render an empty query.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea user's or organization's Projects page, submitting a search filters the list but reloads with the search box empty, and the Open, Closed and sort links drop the search, so switching state or sort loses it.
In Gitea, after a project search, the page fails to retain the query for its controls. Choosing a sort navigates with an empty q and restores unrelated projects.

On a Gitea user's Projects page, after searching within one status (for example Closed), clicking the other status filter (Open) shows every project in that status with an empty search box instead of keeping the search.

logicalBugs.description: On a Gitea user’s or organization’s Projects list, first choose a nondefault sort and then submit a search. The matching projects return in newest-first order instead of preserving the selected ordering while narrowing the results.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The project search form carries state but no current sort input; its GET submission therefore drops sort.
reproductionPaths: On a Gitea user’s or organization’s Projects page, choose a nondefault sort and then submit a search. The matching projects revert to newest-first ordering rather than retaining the selected sort.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, interface language settings offer Bulgarian (Български) as a selectable language. Saving it reports success, but settings, navigation and the rest of the observed interface remain in English instead of switching to the chosen language.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The language list advertises bg-BG, but the bundled options/locale tree contains no Bulgarian locale file, so lookup falls back.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, interface language settings offer Bulgarian (Български) as a selectable language. Saving it reports success, but settings, navigation and the rest of the observed interface remain in English instead of switching to the chosen language.

logicalBugs.description: In Gitea, with Spanish selected as the interface language, the hidden-comment settings include a label for added-commit comments. It reads “Commits añandidos” instead of “Commits añadidos,” a misspelling in the translated label.
logicalBugs.rootCause: The locale value contains añandidos rather than añadidos.
reproductionPaths: In Gitea, with Spanish selected as the interface language, the hidden-comment settings include a label for added-commit comments. It reads “Commits añandidos” instead of “Commits añadidos,” a misspelling in the translated label.
